INTJ-A/T.sum: Imaginative and strategic thinker, with a plan for everything.
INTJ-A/T.aspects: Pioneering Spirit, Thirst for Knowledge, Social Frustrations, The Chess Game of Life
INTJ-A/T.strengths: Rational, Informed, Independent, Determined, Curious, Original
INTJ-A/T.weaknesses: Arrogant, Dissmissive of Emotions, Overly Critical, Combative, Socially Clueless

INTP-A/T.sum: Innovative inventor with an unquenchable thirst for knowledge.
INTP-A/T.aspects: The Life of the Mind, Elementary, My Dear Logician, Mysteries of the Universe

ENTJ-A/T.sum: Bold, imaginative and strong-willed leader, always finding a way – or making one.
ENTJ-A/T.aspects: Striving for Greatness, Give Me a Worthy Challenge
ENTJ-A/T.strengths: Efficient, Energetic, Self-Confident, Strong-Willed, Strategic Thinker, Charismatic, Inspiring
ENTJ-A/T.weaknesses: Stubborn, Dominant, Intolerant, Impatient, Arrogant, Poor Handling of Emotions

ENTP-A/T.sum: Smart and curious thinker who cannot resist an intellectual challenge.
ENTP-A/T.strengths: Knowledgeable, Quick Thinker, Original, Excellent Brainstormer, Charismatic, Energetic
ENTP-A/T.weaknesses: Very Argumentative, Insensitive, Intolerant, Difficulty Focusing, Dislike Practical Matters

INFJ-A/T.sum: Quiet and mystical, yet very inspiring and tireless idealist.
INFJ-A/T.aspects: Seeking Purpose, Connecting with Others, A personal Mission
INFJ-A/T.weaknesses: Sensitive to Criticism, Reluctant to Open Up, Perfectionist, Avoiding the Ordinary, Prone to Burnout

INFP-A/T.sum: Poetic, kind and altruistic person, always eager to help a good cause.
INFP-A/T.aspects: The Gift of Empathy, Speak My Truth, In Search of a Calling
INFP-A/T.strengths: Empathetic, Generous, Open-Minded, Creative, Passionate, Idealistic
INFP-A/T.weaknesses: Unrealistic, Self-Isolating, Unfocused, Emotionally Vulnerable, To Eager to Please, Self-Critical

ENFJ-A/T.sum: Charismatic and inspiring leader, able to mesmerize their listeners.
ENFJ-A/T.aspects: Speaking Up for What's Right, Getting Involved, Leading the Way
ENFJ-A/T.weaknesses: Unrealistic, Overly Idealistic, Condescending, Intense, Overly Empathetic

ENFP-A/T.sum: Enthusiastic, creative and sociable free spirit, who can always find a reason to smile.
ENFP-A/T.aspects: The Magic of Everyday Life, Seeking Joy, Infectious Enthusiasm
ENFP-A/T.strengths: Curious, Perceptive, Enthusiastic, Excellent Communicator, Easygoing, Good-Natured, Positive
ENFP-A/T.weaknesses: People Pleasing, Unfocused, Disorganized, Overly Accommodating, Overly Optimisic, Restless

ISTJ-A/T.sum: Practical and fact-minded individual, whose reliability cannot be doubted.
ISTJ-A/T.aspects: A Life of Integrity, Picking up the Slack
ISTJ-A/T.strengths: Honest, Direct, Disciplined, Very Responsible, Calm, Practical, Organized, Effective, Research-Oriented
ISTJ-A/T.weaknesses: Stubborn, Insensitive, Always by the Book, Judgemental, Prone to Burnout

ISFJ-A/T.sum: Very dedicated and warm protector, always ready to defend their loved ones.
ISFJ-A/T.aspects: The Gift of Loyalty, The Highest of Standards, Showing Up for Others - And Themselves
ISFJ-A/T.strengths: Supportive, Reliable, Observant, Enthusiastic, Hardworking, Good Practical Skills
ISFJ-A/T.weaknesses: Overly Humble, Take Things Personally, Repressed Feelings, Reluctant to Change, Too Altruistic

ESTJ-A/T.sum: Excellent administrator, unsurpassed at managing things – or people.
ESTJ-A/T.strengths: Dedicated, Strong-Willed, Direct, Honest, Loyal, Patient, Reliable, Enjoy Creating Order, Excellent Organizer
ESTJ-A/T.weaknesses: Inflexible, Stubborn, Uncomfortable with Change, Judgemental, Too Focused on Social Status, Difficulty Relaxing, Difficulty Expressing Emotion

ESFJ-A/T.sum: Extraordinarily caring, social and popular person, always eager to help.
ESFJ-A/T.aspects: Clear Moral Compass, The Beauty of a Responsible Life, Building Relationships that Last
ESFJ-A/T.strengths: Strong Practical Skills, Strong Sense of Duty, Very Loyal, Sensitive, Warm, Good at Connecting with Others
ESFJ-A/T.weaknesses: Worried about their Social Status, Inflexible, Vulnerable to Criticism, Often too Needy, Too Selfless
